test_title: SSC MTS Official Paper (Held On: 19 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. Some M are N.

II. No J is N.

**Conclusion:**

I. No N is J.

II. Some N are M.

III. All J are M.

options.text: Both conclusions I and III follows
Both conclusions I and II follows
Both conclusions II and III follows

solution:
Statements:

I. Some M are N.

II. No J is N.

The Venn diagram as per the given statements:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a87462a7f3bac8f8f0f861381c7ace1d3db6c17e8081a3ed61c67c4e6d188d0d.png] 

Conclusion:

I. No N is J. → **Follow** (No J is N, which means No N is J is definitely true)

II. Some N are M. → **Follow** (Some M are N, which means some N are M is definitely true)

III. All J are M. → **Not follow** (Because some M are n and no N is J, which means all J are M is definitely false)

Hence, the correct answer is "**Both conclusions I and II follow**".
